statement: Every finite nonsolvable subgroup of the positive punctured-sphere geometric completion is abstractly A5, with precisely the icosahedral puncture-permutation orbit pattern 12a+20b+30c+60m, a,b,c in {0,1}. In the extended sphere completion the nonsolvable abstract groups are A5 and A5 times C2. Every finite subgroup of a genus-one or genus-two geometric completion is solvable, with arbitrary puncture number and orientation reversal.
depends_on: R-BZ Theorem A and genus-at-most-two goodness
manuscript_passages: Part D(b): finite subgroups of the geometric completion and full completion comparison
notes: Every completion injection is proved: finite generated kernel with good quotient, full twist detected by braid abelianization, diagonal torus translation loops detected by total strand homology. Continuous transfer embeds the finite-subgroup pullbacks into Zhat or Zhat^2, avoiding a Schur-theorem shortcut. Gorenstein-Walter's abelian 2-complement hypothesis is established through the completed two-branch-point quotient. The finite search supports explicit finite maps only; the group restriction is proved for all primes. Geometric conjugacy of A5 and its ambient completed centralizer comparison remain open.
